title: Mary & Martha
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible story 
you will hear that Jesus visits his friends, 
Mary and Martha

The 2 sisters do things very differently…
Mary just wants to hear everything that Jesus has to say
While her sister, Martha just wants clean and cook

Martha gets cross because she is doing all the work
BUT JESUS SAYS THAT MARY MADE THE RIGHT CHOICE

MARY PUT JESUS FIRST

CHAT TIME
Which 2 sisters did Jesus visit? (Mary & Martha)
Do you know what their brothers name was? (Lazurus)
Which sister sat at Jesus feet listening to Jesus? (Mary)
Who got cross with Mary? (Martha)
Why? (Martha felt it was unfair that she had to do all the work and Mary was just sitting)
Who did Jesus say was right?(Mary)

HOW CAN WE LISTEN TO JESUS?
WHAT DO WE DO THAT DISTRACTS US FROM JESUS?
